bullets: Own and evolve Chamber's roadmap for interoperability, external integrations, APIs, and supporting platform capabilities.

Partner closely with Engineering, Data, Clinical, and Operations to evaluate architectural tradeoffs, integration patterns, and build-versus-buy decisions, and to ensure…
Balance immediate integration needs with longer-term investments in reliability, scalability, maintainability, and operational efficiency.
